description: Document-intelligence tools for an agent: extract named fields from ONE document, or suggest a field schema from ONE sample document. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under.

default_model.label: Default Model
default_model.description: Fallback LLM model (litellm format) used when a tool call doesn't specify its own `model`.

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Environment variable name holding the API key.

api_base_env_var.label: Api Base Env Var
api_base_env_var.description: Optional environment variable holding an API base URL, for a self-hosted or local OpenAI-compatible model (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM...), e.g. OLLAMA_API_BASE=http://localhost:11434 with model 'ollama/llava'. Unset = the provider's default endpoint.

llm_max_retries.label: Llm Max Retries
llm_max_retries.description: Retry a tool call's LLM call up to this many times on transient errors (rate limits, timeouts) -- forwarded to litellm's own num_retries.

max_content_chars.label: Max Content Chars
max_content_chars.description: Truncate extracted document text to this many characters before prompting the LLM -- guards against blowing the model's context window or racking up cost on unusually large text-PDF/text-input documents. Doesn't apply to image documents (sent as a vision content block, not text). Set to null to disable.

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Hard allow-list of tools (default: all). Valid: extract, suggest_schema.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource under this key (python -m this module, with DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_TOOLS_* env vars set from this component's own config). Any mcp_servers-aware component can then reference it via server_resource_key.

mcp_extra_env_vars.label: Mcp Extra Env Vars
mcp_extra_env_vars.description: mcp_server_resource_key only. Extra env var NAMES to copy into the spawned MCP server's env.

review_queue_approval_dir.label: Review Queue Approval Dir
review_queue_approval_dir.description: Approval directory used by AgentReviewQueueComponent (the SAME `approval_dir` value your review-queue asset scans). When set, `extract` writes a pending review record to `<review_queue_approval_dir>/pending/<key>.json` whenever the LLM call errors, or too many requested fields come back null/empty -- feeding the exact same human review queue agentic_pipeline's `approve` step feeds. Unset (default) = feature off; `extract` stays fully read-only and never writes anything.

low_confidence_null_rate_threshold.label: Low Confidence Null Rate Threshold
low_confidence_null_rate_threshold.description: Only used when `review_queue_approval_dir` is set. Fraction (0-1) of requested `output_fields` that came back null/empty above which `extract` queues the result for review. There is no real confidence score anywhere in this extraction pipeline -- this null-rate is a deliberate, honest proxy, not a fabricated model-confidence estimate. An LLM-call exception always queues regardless of this threshold.

additional_prompt.label: Additional Prompt
additional_prompt.description: Extra domain/document context appended to every `extract` call's prompt, e.g. 'preserve signed amounts' or 'this is a redacted legal filing'. Steering, not a hard constraint -- the model can still omit a field it genuinely can't find. Applies to every `extract` call this toolset serves.

detect_selections.label: Detect Selections
detect_selections.description: `extract` also asks the model to identify checkboxes, radio buttons, and handwritten selection marks, returned as an extra `selection_marks` key on the result's `fields`: [{'label': str, 'checked': bool}]. Selection-mark detection is a VISUAL signal -- it only runs when `file_ref` resolves to an image; a text-layer PDF or raw text has nothing to detect against, so that call gets `selection_marks: None` (not attempted, logged as a warning) rather than an empty list (which would mean 'attempted, found none'). Rendering PDF pages to images so this can run against them is not done here.

refine.label: Refine
refine.description: After `extract`'s first-pass extraction succeeds, make ONE additional LLM call that reviews the first pass against the SAME original content (reused, not re-read) for OCR/text-reading mistakes, wrong table structure, and number/currency formatting, and returns a corrected result in place of the first pass's. This is a single corrective pass -- not a multi-mode (tables/text/formatting/layout) review pipeline -- a deliberate, honestly-scoped improvement, not a stand-in for one. Doubles the LLM calls (and cost/latency) for every `extract` call.

refine_model.label: Refine Model
refine_model.description: Model used for the refine pass only (litellm format). Unset = reuse the call's own model for both passes. Only used when refine=true.
